defs.meaning: 仆人，佣人；（公司或机构的）雇员，职员；献身……的人，受……指引的人
【名】 （Servant）（西）塞尔万特，（法）塞尔旺（人名）

examples.en: "What does your father do?"—"Well, he's a civil servant."
examples.zh: “你父亲是做什么工作的？”— “哦，他是个公务员。”

examples.en: He was a loyal, distinguished and very competent civil servant.
examples.zh: 他是一个忠诚、出色、很有能力的公务员。

examples.en: His work as a civil servant was a cover for his activities as a spy.
examples.zh: 他以公务员的工作作为搞间谍活动的掩护。
